definitions.full: H3854. lahag לַ֫הַג noun masculine (late) study , i.e. devotion to books; ׳ל בָּשָׂר יְגִעַת הַרְבֵּה Eccl 12:12 (compare Now).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to be eager;

occurrences.englishText: Furthermore, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.
